envelope.description: Guard final channel signing and sequence allocation

body.title: Guard final channel signing and sequence allocation
body.summary: Build protected final signer orchestration from exact-candidate verification and evidence checks. Serialize durable sequence allocation per repository, target, final lane and channel before releasing the detached final signature. S3 consumes this signer contract to publish. Use a protected shared sequence authority with atomic compare-and-set for independent jobs and processes.
acceptanceChecks: Recheck authenticated qualification grant, evidence, exact bytes and ref policy. No signing job executes candidate code.
Competing manifests claiming one sequence cannot both be signed. Include exact retry across interruption, scope independence, and stale/corrupt ledger refusal.
Interrupt after durable binding and before delivery and retry the exact manifest. Race independent writers and verify at most one distinct digest obtains a binding.

tests.name: Independent-writer sequence race, scoped ledger, stale and corrupt ledger, and interrupted exact retry
Final signing role, evidence and origin checks across all Linux stages using fixtures
